title: Peaceful protest — dispersal order
officerCan: Enforce a valid order restricting assembly, where one is in force for that place and time.
officerCannot: Assert an order that is not in force, or refuse to identify it.
Treat peaceful assembly as unlawful in the absence of such an order.

quotableLine.en: May I know which order is in force here, and for what area and time? We will comply.
quotableLine.hi: क्या मैं जान सकता हूँ कि यहाँ कौन सा आदेश लागू है, किस क्षेत्र और समय के लिए? हम पालन करेंगे।

doNotSay: Any refusal of a dispersal direction.
documentNow: Whether an order was identified, and the exact words used to direct dispersal.

options.label: Begin moving as directed while asking which order is in force.
options.rationale: Compliance first protects you; the question preserves the legal point.

options.label: Record the order number, area and time if given.
options.rationale: This is what a lawyer needs to test whether the order applied to you.

options.label: Move to a distance and continue documenting.
options.rationale: Keeps the record going without being inside the dispersal.

verification.notes: Placeholder from PRD table. Not checked against bare act. Needs advocate sign-off for legal accuracy AND for escalation risk (PRD R3).
